name: chendoc
description: ChenDoc / Chen Shu commercial document management and knowledge publishing platform.

scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run start
scripts.dev:admin: npm --prefix apps/admin run build && node scripts/copy-admin-dist.js
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/admin run build && node scripts/copy-admin-dist.js && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix apps/admin run test && npm --workspace @chendoc/server run test
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:test && node node_modules/playwright/cli.js test
scripts.build:test: npm --prefix apps/admin run build:test && node scripts/copy-admin-dist.js && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/admin run typecheck && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.check: npm run check:architecture && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run security:audit
scripts.admin:init: cross-env CHENDOC_E2E_TESTING=true CHENDOC_ALLOW_WEAK_ADMIN_PASSWORD=true npm --prefix server run admin:init
